summary: Learn mobile data collection with our ODK and Kobo Toolbox course. Master essential skills to streamline data gathering and enhance your research projects.
lede: Mobile data collection with ODK and KoboToolbox provides a repeatable workflow for designing, deploying, synchronising, and quality-checking structured field surveys. You will build XLSForm questionnaires, apply skip logic and constraints, capture consent, support offline data collection, and review submissions for quality. Through hands-on practice, you will publish projects in KoboToolbox, test ODK Collect and KoboCollect on Android devices, and prepare analysis-ready CSV exports. You will also create practical tools such as a data dictionary, form testing log, enumerator checklist, submission review sheet, data quality protocol, and basic monitoring dashboard.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who design, supervise, collect, review, or use structured field data through mobile devices. It supports foundation-to-intermediate learners who need practical capability with XLSForm, ODK, and KoboToolbox rather than software engineering depth.
modules: Mobile Survey Foundations and Field Design
ODK Collect and KoboCollect Field Operations
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic experience using spreadsheets and a working familiarity with surveys, monitoring activities, research data, or field operations. Bring a laptop with a modern web browser and, where possible, an Android device for ODK Collect or KoboCollect testing. The course focuses on operational application and guided form building, not technical engineering or custom server development.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
